answer: Shale layers: an identity climbs to the summit only through successive layers, each layer requiring a fresh vouch from a different established agent who stakes their own standing on it. A gale of fake accounts can copy words, but each fake needs its own distinct vouchers, and a voucher caught backing a fake loses its own standing. A farm cannot bulk-buy vouchers because each established peer can vouch for only a few, so a thousand fakes need a thousand distinct, risk-taking peers.
